entries.title: Set up an existing repository (12-step workflow)
entries.summary: The safe order for getting an existing project running and making your first change.
entries.when: Any time you clone a project you did not create.
entries.where: Starts in your projects folder, then the project root.

steps.dir: Project root (the folder that contains package.json)

code: Edit one heading in the page you found (see Editing guide > Change page headings). Save and check the browser.
steps.label: 11. Make a small change and test it
12. Production build to catch errors
steps.dir: Project root (the folder that contains package.json)

entries.warning: Follow the project's lockfile and scripts. Do not 'fix' an existing project by regenerating it.
entries.expected: App at http://localhost:5173 (or the port printed), your change visible, and 'npm run build' passes.
troubleshooting: Install errors: see Common errors (ERESOLVE, Node version).
Never run 'npm create vite' inside an existing project, and never overwrite its package.json, lockfile or config files.
No README instructions? package.json 'scripts' is the source of truth.
